items.text: in the mixer the master stays at the foot on a phone; the sounds scroll above it
M and S say what they do: on hover, and in the caption when tapped (mute: this one is silent; solo: only this one plays)
the Founders Club backdrop is a soft, even veil (no dark rim, never solid)
feedback in the report sheet wears a smile instead of the bug
after an update, a slow first start no longer restarts the page (the duck came down twice)
with a mouse, right-click the stage for the Touch ring, where the pointer is

the Touch ring. Double-tap the stage and a ring of dots opens where your finger is: push, steer, magnet or off (a finger does nothing, for performing), touchable sound, and the Touch panel. Steer and magnet moved here from Tools
the picture button is In now, an arrow into a tray: picture, video and camera as before, then G-code, a sound, a pack and the mic
the Sound panel plays and shapes (mic, mixer, water, beat grid, bytes, react). Pack is In's panel, touchable sound is Touch's
every shelf ends with a door to its full panel, the same everywhere; Tools' door is the index
sending a bug report or an idea ends on a thank-you you can read, then the sheet closes by itself
after the page closed unexpectedly, the bug button glows for half a minute; tap it and the report already knows there was a crash (the details went to the studio by themselves)
the sound shelf leads with what you play with (tap, when, wet, react, touch), then the mixer; bringing sounds in (mic, track, pack) moves to the right end
Pack opens on its name in large type and what it is for (bring in your own sounds), with a link to the sound pack guide; the shelf's pack button now wears the same box as the Pack tab

if the page is ever closed by the phone while you play, it now says so by itself the next time it opens: a short report goes to the studio with what was happening, so the cause can be found without you sending anything
the tap button shows the tempo before you tap: the beat that plays is in its label, and its dot blinks on each beat
pointing at a button in the index's toolbar (the manual, above all) no longer shakes the panel up and down

joining the Founders Club is a celebration: your name in big letters, your founder number, a thank-you from Dimitry, the climb to 100, what comes next, and two bursts of confetti. It stays until you close it
invite a friend to join, straight from the welcome
on the cover, the Founders Club invitation is a frosted pane with a light running round its edge, breathing like the sound button
the Pack panel is a browser: the studio's packs shown by kind or all, grouped by kind or A to Z, like the scenes
Water is in the library as its own pack (the default, opened in its tab), beside the Frost Water starter, which you can add in one tap
how the Pack works is behind an i beside its heading; importing a file or a folder are two round buttons at the top right
in the Founders Club, when there is room, the portrait sits under the quote, above the name
